title: xanthoxalis dillenii var. piletorum
intro: Xanthoxalis dillenii var. piletorum, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the Oxalidaceae family. This plant is known for its edible leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their potential health benefits, including the ability to help reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Xanthoxalis dillenii var. piletorum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
